about: A JavaScript library that turns web page snippets into editable Word documents.

prs.title: Plain text outside any tag stays in the document
prs.broken: Text that was not inside a tag was left out of the Word file. "Your order #123 has shipped" came out as just "#123", and plain text gave an empty document.
prs.changed: Loose text, and the spaces between bits of bold or italic text, now go into the document with everything else.
prs.matters: Letters and messages built from simple snippets keep every word.

prs.title: List items written as paragraphs keep their numbers
prs.broken: List items whose text sat inside a paragraph lost their number or bullet, which is how Markdown writes lists with blank lines between items.
prs.changed: The list numbering now goes on paragraphs inside a list item too.
prs.matters: Markdown turned into Word keeps its numbered and bulleted lists.

prs.title: Numbered lists continue from where they left off
prs.broken: A numbered list that picked up again after a code block started over at 1, because its starting number was ignored.
prs.changed: A list with a start number now gets its own numbering that begins there.
prs.matters: Step-by-step guides keep the right step numbers in Word.
